daily.today_energy: You're giving main character energy today, Cap. The universe is whispering that it's time to stop overthinking and just *do* the thing. Trust the timing, even if it feels a little messy.
daily.love: Whether you're single or coupled up, today's about authenticity over performance. Show up as your real self—imperfections and all. Someone's gonna appreciate the realness.
daily.career: Your efforts from last week are starting to compound in ways you'll notice today. Keep the momentum going, but don't burn out chasing validation. Progress over perfection.
daily.health: Your body's asking for gentleness today. Move in ways that feel good rather than punishing. A walk, some stretching, or just resting—whatever makes you feel grounded and alive.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is inviting you to soften your edges, cap. You've been grinding hard, and the cosmos is gently suggesting it's time to let people in. Trust the unfolding.
weekly.love: Venus is whispering that vulnerability is actually your superpower right now. Whether single or coupled, authenticity attracts the right energy. Show up as you are, not as you think you should be.
weekly.career: Mercury's movements suggest this is a stellar week for collaboration over solo efforts. Your usually independent vibe will flourish when you lean on others' perspectives. Fresh ideas are incoming.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for balance between discipline and rest. Consider swapping intensity for intentional movement that feels good. Listen to what brings you ease, not just what challenges you.
